description: This is a Java interface defining service methods related to self-beneficiaries and transfer platform templates within the Fineract project. It includes method signatures for retrieving beneficiary data, account template data, and transfer limits.

classes.name: SelfBeneficiariesTPTReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface that declares methods for retrieving self-beneficiaries and account template data, as well as transfer limits in a financial application.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Returns a collection of all SelfBeneficiariesTPTData entries.

methods.name: retrieveTPTSelfAccountTemplateData
methods.description: Retrieves self account template data for a given user.

methods.name: getTransferLimit
methods.description: Returns the transfer limit for a specific entity identified by id, accountId, and accountType.
